name: varex-business-management-system
description: VAREX Business Management System web and native mobile application

scripts.android:add: npm run build:web && cap add android
scripts.android:sync: npm run build:web && cap sync android
scripts.android:debug: npm run android:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.android:release: npm run android:sync && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease
scripts.ios:add: npm run build:web && cap add ios
scripts.ios:sync: npm run build:web && cap sync ios
